title: Bạn có thể đánh vần tên cho tôi được không?
englishTitle: Can you spell the name for me?
pronunciation: Ban co the danh van ten cho toi duoc khong
summary: For getting a hotel, driver, ticket desk, or contact name letter by letter so you can copy it correctly.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Good when a name is spoken too quickly to type. Open the form, note, or booking screen first.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Hold the phone or paper where they can see it. Let them spell, then repeat the letters or show what you typed.

phrases.vietnamese: Bạn có thể đánh vần tên cho tôi được không?
phrases.english: Can you spell the name for me?
phrases.pronunciation: Ban co the danh van ten cho toi duoc khong

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Bạn có thể asks can you; đánh vần tên means spell the name; cho tôi được không makes it a polite request.

breakdown.vietnamese: Bạn có thể đánh vần tên cho tôi được không?
breakdown.english: Can you spell the name for me?

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Slower, repeat, and write-down cards stay nearby for moments when a name, address, or number still is not landing.

phrases.english: Can you speak a little slower?

phrases.vietnamese: Nói chậm giúp tôi được không?
phrases.english: Could you speak a little slower, please?
phrases.pronunciation: noy chuhm zoop toy dook khong

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Best at hotel desks, ticket counters, phone calls on speaker, ride pickup points, and forms where one wrong letter matters.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Vietnamese names may include tone marks. If exact spelling matters, ask them to type it or check your screen.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Move to say-again, write-down, meaning, which-one, or show-me cards if the spelling turns into another clarification.
